data.long_meaning: Arjuna's Victorious Son Arjun is a legendary warrior from the Mahabharata. Arjunkumar means 'Son of Arjuna'. This name is a tribute to the brave and noble qualities of Arjuna, passed down to his son. The name Arjunkumar carries the meaning “Son of Arjuna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjunkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody son of arjuna and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arjunkumar holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, especially for those who are fans of epics and ancient Indian history. Arjuna is one of the most revered characters in Indian mythology, known for his bravery, dedication, and strong bond with his god-mentor Bhagvan Krishna. Naming a child Arjunkumar pays homage to this legendary character and his virtues.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Arjunkumar stems from the divine guidance received by Arjuna from Lord Krishna throughout the Mahabharata. This name can symbolically inspire the child to seek the same kind of wisdom and compassion in their own life journey. It is a reminder to live a virtuous life, appreciate the support and guidance from elders, and strive for truth, justice, and morality in the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arjun signifies 'pure' or 'spotless', symbolizing one's inner purity and devotion to dharma. Kumar represents 'prince' or 'youth', signifying the potential for growth and leadership in one's spiritual and moral journey. Together, Arjunkumar signifies a pure-hearted young warrior, dedicated to his dharma.

historical_references.reference: Arjuna, also known as Arjunakumar, was a prominent character in the Indian epic Mahabharata. He was the third of the five Pandava brothers and was the greatest archer of his time. Arjuna received the blessings of Lord Krishna, who became his charioteer and mentor during the Kurukshetra war.

Arjuna, also known as Arjunakumar, was an important prince in the Gupta Empire around the 6th century CE. He was the eldest son of King Bhartrihari and Queen Prabhavati. Arjunakumar is mentioned in various Gupta inscriptions and was an active ruler during the imperial period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Arjunkumar is a combination of Arjun, a popular character in Hindu mythology, and Kumar, meaning 'prince' or 'young lord' in Sanskrit. This name is becoming increasingly popular in modern contexts across various platforms. In social media, Arjunkumar is used as a unique username or display name by individuals who are fond of Indian culture or mythology. In the entertainment industry, it is used for character names in movies, TV shows, or web series that depict Indian mythology or culture. Lastly, in technology companies, it is used as a name for products, services, or projects related to India or Hindu mythology.
